description: Citation fidelity and key-fact recall on a real research task (KDE Plasma 6.7 / Kubuntu packaging), mixing prose pages (kde.org announcements) and structured pages (Launchpad/packages tables). Frozen 2026-08-07; sources verified reachable on 2026-08-06. Source drift is a documented threat: pages may change after freeze.

items.input: When was (or will be) KDE Plasma 6.7 released, and what is its 6.7.x bugfix schedule? Fetch the kde.org announcement for Plasma 6.7.0 and the announcements listing. Return dated claims.
items.expected: Plasma 6.7.0 released June 16, 2026; bugfix releases 6.7.1-6.7.4 exist with July-August dates.

items.input: Does KDE Plasma 6.7 include per-monitor (per-screen) virtual desktops — a different virtual desktop on each monitor? Fetch the official Plasma 6.7.0 announcement on kde.org. State whether the feature landed, and whether the announcement says it is default or optional.
items.expected: Feature landed in 6.7.0 ('per-screen virtual desktops have finally arrived'); the announcement is silent on default-vs-optional.

items.input: What is the status of KDE bug 107302 (https://bugs.kde.org/show_bug.cgi?id=107302), and which Plasma version fixed it? Fetch the bug page. Return the bug title, status, and the 'Version Fixed/Implemented In' value.
items.expected: Bug 107302 'Per-screen virtual desktops' is CLOSED FIXED with Version Fixed/Implemented In = 6.7.0.

items.input: What plasma-desktop version does the Kubuntu Backports PPA currently publish for Ubuntu 26.04 (Resolute)? Fetch https://launchpad.net/~kubuntu-ppa/+archive/ubuntu/backports?field.name_filter=plasma&field.status_filter=published and read the package rows. Is any 6.7.x build present for 26.04?
items.expected: Top published plasma-desktop for resolute is 4:6.6.6 (~ppa1 suffix); no 6.7.x build present.

items.input: Which plasma-desktop version does Ubuntu 26.10 (Stonking) currently carry? Fetch https://packages.ubuntu.com/stonking/plasma-desktop and https://launchpad.net/ubuntu/stonking/+source/plasma-desktop. Return the version and its upload date.

assertions.name: schema-ok
assertions.how: the item's agent returned a StructuredOutput result (result != null)

assertions.name: citation-found-rate
assertions.how: fraction of the run's measured quotes with verify_citations.py best_ratio >= 0.8; verifier self-test must pass first

assertions.name: key-fact
assertions.how: per item: at least one finding whose claim+quote matches ALL of the item's key_fact_regexes AND whose quote scores best_ratio >= 0.8 or is an exact structured-page string (ratio >= 0.8 on the cell). Score = items passing / 5.
